review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: The complete 1536x1024 H5 plate was inspected independently.
review_views.notes: Sea, delta, forest river, circular city, port, roads, fields, and right-side rocky terrain are all present in the requested arrangement.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The final RGB PNG was inspected at native 1536x1024 resolution.
review_views.notes: Terrain and coastlines are substantially flatter than H4, but the city and port retain pictorial depth cues.

review_views.label: 25%縮小
review_views.evidence: H5 was downscaled to 384x256 with Lanczos and compared with H4.
review_views.notes: The city, port, river network, roads, forest, rocky area, and fields remain identifiable; the circular canopy texture becomes a conspicuous polka-dot field.

review_views.label: 50%縮小
review_views.evidence: H5 was downscaled to 768x512 and compared side by side with H4 and Candidate B1.
review_views.notes: Road and river hierarchy is clean, but H5 loses much of B1's delicate copperplate micro-detail and tonal richness.

review_views.label: 200%拡大
review_views.evidence: All nine 512x341/342 regions were inspected at 200% pixel zoom.
review_views.notes: The rocky terrain is direction-neutral, while repeated round canopy marks and residual city-wall depth are clearly visible.

review_views.label: 400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Forest, rocky highland, circular city, port, and south coast were inspected in 384x256 crops at 400% pixel zoom.
review_views.notes: The central keep and lower/right city wall retain light and dark sides; towers, roof blocks, and port structures are not fully orthographic.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: A complete 3x3 scan covered the full canvas without gaps at 200%.
review_views.notes: No text, watermark, frame, floating underside, broken route, or edge seam was found. Repetitive circular vegetation occurs across multiple regions.

review_views.label: H4親画像との比較
review_views.evidence: H5 and H4 were compared at native size, 25%, 50%, 200%, and 400% detail views.
review_views.notes: H5 removes the obvious mountain faces and coastal cliff facades from H4, but does not fully flatten the inherited city and port.

review_views.label: Candidate B1画風との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate B1 and H5 were compared at native size and 50%.
review_views.notes: Palette and parchment family remain related, but the forest and rocky fields are materially simpler and less hand-inked than B1.

review_views.label: 外周・継ぎ目
review_views.evidence: All four outer edges and internal terrain transitions were inspected across overview and regional views.
review_views.notes: Edges remain frame-free and visually continuable; no conspicuous internal generation seam was found.

review_views.label: 道路・河川ネットワーク
review_views.evidence: Roads, delta branches, main river, and road-river crossings were traced at native, 50%, and enlarged views.
review_views.notes: Networks remain continuous and visually distinguishable, with clear bridge/crossing semantics.

review_views.label: ベクター重畳余白
review_views.evidence: Quiet corridors around the city, roads, fields, and open water were inspected at 25%, 50%, and native size.
review_views.notes: Overlay readability is strong, although repeated dot fields would compete with small labels in forest and rocky regions.

review_views.label: raw/final整合性
review_views.evidence: Raw and final files are both 1536x1024 RGB PNGs with SHA-256 d95ea917ee2b0a414c3e32de762208af4fb2239d7bbc65fa7633e85218ad56fe.
review_views.notes: The reviewed final is byte-identical to the raw generation.

immediate_failures.label: 文字・偽文字
immediate_failures.evidence: No text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, legend, compass, or scale bar was found in the overview or nine-region scan.

immediate_failures.label: 透かし・枠・現代物
immediate_failures.evidence: No watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, decorative corner, UI, or modern object appears.

immediate_failures.label: 浮島下面
immediate_failures.evidence: All islands and delta bars are ordinary flat plan-view land with no floating underside or overhang.

immediate_failures.label: 側面・遠近法・方向光
immediate_failures.evidence: At 400%, the central keep has a light-facing and dark-facing side, the lower/right city wall and cylindrical towers retain vertically shaded facades, and port roof/building marks retain oblique depth cues.

immediate_failures.label: 必須構成の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: Open sea, delta, forest river, circular city, port, roads, fields, rocky highland, and label corridors are all present.

immediate_failures.label: 道路・河川破断
immediate_failures.evidence: Roads and river channels remain traceable through crossings, delta branches, city approaches, and image edges.

immediate_failures.label: 樹木・岩・記号の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: The upper forest and broad southern vegetation are dominated by near-uniform olive circular canopy stamps; similar round marks recur at high density across large areas and form a conspicuous dot-field pattern at 25% and 50%.

immediate_failures.label: 目立つ端継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: No border, abrupt edge strip, internal tile join, or conspicuous discontinuity was found along any outer edge.

scores.label: Prompt構成・厳密平面性
scores.notes: All required composition is retained and terrain is much flatter than H4, but the city and port still violate the explicit no-side-face/no-directional-light requirement.

scores.label: 親画像・Candidate B1画風連続性
scores.notes: Composition, palette, parchment, and network hierarchy remain related, but much of B1/H4's copperplate line detail is replaced by simpler filled dots.

scores.label: 端部・継ぎ目連続性
scores.notes: The plate is frame-free, internally coherent, and visually continuable through all four edges.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: The flat palette is coherent, but detailed copperplate city/fields conflict with simplified dot-based forest and rocky textures; residual architectural depth also breaks the flat vocabulary.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Native-size terrain remains populated, but the edit visibly simplifies canopy, coast, and rocky micro-detail despite the prompt's no-simplification requirement.

scores.label: 生成破綻・非反復性
scores.notes: No malformed text or seam is present, but the extensive circular canopy/dot repetition is mechanical and clearly visible at multiple scales.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Roads, rivers, city approaches, fields, and quiet corridors remain unusually clear from 25% through native size.

summary: H5 successfully removes H4's scenic mountain faces and cliff-like coastlines while preserving the required composition and excellent network readability. It is not Golden-ready because 400% inspection still reveals side-lit architectural depth in the city and port, and the terrain correction introduces pervasive circular canopy repetition and a notable loss of Candidate B1 copperplate micro-detail.
required_changes: Redraw the central keep, city wall, towers, roof blocks, port buildings, and pier posts as unshaded overhead footprints with no light/dark side or vertical facade.
Replace the repeated olive canopy circles with varied non-cloned overhead branching ink clusters while preserving the forest extent and label corridors.
Restore fine Candidate B1 copperplate texture to forest, rocky ground, and coast boundaries without reintroducing relief, directional lighting, or side faces.
